rows.notes: Male, frd_pnn_006; cut off by Hoshimura.

rows.en:
Heyyy, \p!
Whatcha doing in a place like this?

Hey, Hoshimura.
I promised to hang out with Pinon-chan,
so I'm waiting here to meet her.

Whaaat, a date alone with Pino-Pino? No fair~
I wanna hang out with Pino-Pino too~
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Pino-Pino as in earlier slices.

rows.en: Hmm, then do you want to hang out with us?
Really? Really?
Yaaay~~!!

...is what I'd like to say, but I've actually
got stuff to do after this, so I can't~

So with that, I shall take my leave.
Give Pino-Pino my regards.
Welp, see ya laterrr~
See ya, Hoshimura.
rows.notes: x2, male player: here and frd_yui_001.

rows.en:
(Seriously, Hoshimura's always so hyper
whenever I run into her...)
You seemed to be having a grand old time...
Whoa! Pinon-chan, you were here?!

I was already here
while you were having your fun little chat.
Then you should've said something.

You were chatting so happily you didn't even
notice me, so I figured it'd be rude to interrupt!
No, we were just talking normally...
Hmph! Likely story.
(Pinon-chan seems kind of grumpy today.)

What's wrong, Pinon-chan?
Aren't you awfully on edge today?

I am NOT on edge!
Just come on, we're going!
Going? Going where?
What does it matter where?!
(Hmm, what should I do...)

I know! Let's eat something sweet and calm down.
Like some ice cream at Folmo.

I am ALWAYS calm! And thinking a few sweets
will fix my mood... You're treating me
like a child...!

Haaah~, this is delicious~
Alright, I'm going to buy another one!
(Looks like her mood's back to normal...)
The ice cream here really is the best!

(Hmm... But why was Pinon-chan
in such a bad mood...?)

(Did I do something
to put Pinon-chan in a bad mood?)

(What should I do with Pinon-chan today?
Going to Folmo wouldn't be so ba...)

Oh, Yui.
I promised to hang out with Pinon-chan,
so I'm waiting here to meet her.

Looks like you were waiting alone today.

Hey, Pinon-chan.
What do you mean, 'alone'?

Last time we met up here,
you were having a lovely chat with Yui...

Oh, that. I just happened to run into Hoshimura
and we talked for a bit, that's all.
Hmph! Well, whatever!

(For some reason, Pinon-chan always gets
grumpy when this comes up...)

Right, there's no point standing around here.
Let's hurry up and go have fun somewhere!

(Well, she seems to be in a good mood today,
so I'll just have fun with Pinon-chan.)

(What should I do with Pinon-chan today?
Well, I can decide once she gets here.)

Oh, Pinon-chan.
What do you mean, 'alone'?

Oh, that. I just happened to run into Yui
and we talked for a bit, that's all.

(For some reason, Pinon-chan always gets
grumpy when this comes up...)

(Today I'm going to enjoy a swim in the sea
at the artificial island with Pinon-chan!)

(Pinon-chan still can't swim,
so I'd better give her plenty of support.)

Sorry I kept you waiting.
It took me a little while to get ready...
No problem. So, shall we go have some fun?
Before that, can I ask just one thing?

Wh-what do you think
when you see me in my swimsuit?
Huh? I think it suits you, and you look cute.

Is there nothing besides 'cute'?
Like... 'sexy'...?

Hmm, I don't think you've grown up enough yet
to be called sexy...

Mmmmmm!!
I-I just look slimmer in clothes!
My chest is actually WAY bigger, you know!!

(Slimmer in clothes...
She's in a swimsuit right now...)

You don't have to force yourself
to act all grown up, Pinon-chan.

I'm not forcing anything!
It's just that you always treat me like a child, so...

(I see...
Pinon-chan pushed herself so hard
because I treated her like a kid...)

You're you, Pinon-chan, so I don't think
you need to push yourself like that.
B-but...

You've still got lots of growing to do,
so you'll be like Sheryl in no time.

Besides, you're cute just the way you are,
Pinon-chan.

Right!
From now on I'll drink hippo-cow milk every day
and get a knockout body like Sheryl's... no, Nanase's!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. 'knockout body' for naisu badi as Klan's lines in finished slices.

rows.en: Haha, go for it, Pinon-chan.
But before that...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; continues in c12303 (slice 168): 'teach me to swim again'.
